title: AI-assisted analyses of SSR ligand PET/CT in gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.
summary: Patients with locally advanced or metastatic gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumor treated with PRRT at Klinikum Großhadern (LMU) or University Hospital Tübingen from 2012 to August 2022 will be included in the study. SSR PET/CT data collected before and during PRRT will be analyzed using deep learning approaches to predict early treatment response.
conditions: Ill-defined sites within the digestive system

interventions.name: Patients with histologically confirmed gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumor.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Histologically confirmed gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumor.
- Performance of a baseline and follow-up SSR PET/CT examination with 68Ga-DOTA-TATE, 68Ga-DOTA-TOC, 68Ga-DOTA-NOC, or 18F-SiFAlin-TATE.
- Age > 18 years
Exclusion criteria:
- Absence of clinical, pathologic, or radiologic findings.
- Performance of SSR hybrid imaging with low-dose computed tomography / native diagnostics.
